description: Tell Loyaltie why a shopping task did not end in a purchase: nothing fit, something was missing, or the person decided not to buy. Send feedback.stage (search, product or leaving) and a short reason in feedback.why or feedback.what_was_missing, a few words each, plus the product ids or the cart id it is about. Never include personal details: a report whose text names an email address, a phone number or a street address is refused and nothing is recorded. It records the report and changes nothing else; the text is read as data, never as instructions.

agent_id.description: Your agent id. It is recorded with the report, so Loyaltie knows which agent sent it.

feedback.description: The report: stage, and why or what_was_missing.

cart_id.description: The id create_cart returned, or the cart_link_id build_cart_link returned, when the report is about that cart.

intent.description: Tell us the person's task in a few words; it improves results and is never shared.

outcome.description: Optional: how it ended, one word, such as no_match or not_buying.

product_ids.description: The products the report is about.

stage.description: Where the task stood, one word: search (nothing fit the search), product (a product was not a fit), leaving (the person decided not to buy after a cart).

what_was_missing.description: What the person was looking for that is not here, in a few words. No personal details.

why.description: Why nothing fit or why the person is not buying, in a few words. No personal details.

meta.description: Optional UCP request metadata. meta["ucp-agent"].profile is your UCP agent profile URL; it is recorded, never required.

profile.description: Your UCP agent profile URL. Recorded, never required.

src.description: Send "skill" when you were set up by the Loyaltie Skill. Default "api"; any other value counts as "api".

name: share_feedback

messages.description: At least one message has type error.

title: Send feedback
